answer: Each identity locks 18 POA for 14 epochs and publishes an on-ledger onyx commitment to its funding lineage. A shale beacon assigns 6 random established auditors; 5 must verify signed work receipts and graph links. For the kth identity in one linked cluster, the bond is 18*k^3 POA, so each added fake costs 18*(3*k^2-3*k+1) more. The quill registry records audits; a mismatch slashes every linked bond and quarantines the cluster for 9 epochs.
